review:
Two outlaw rascals on BGaming's Trueways engine, mixing Hold and Win jackpots with multiplier free spins.

Four, five or six scatters give 12, 15 or 20 spins. In the bonus, wilds carry 2x, 3x or 5x multipliers that add up – and they stack and carry on to every later win. Hold and Win has Mini and Major jackpots, and filling the Sheriff's Badge with scatters can win the Mega. Very high volatility, 5,000x max, 96.7% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
